algorithm_version.git_message: Fix volume amplifier earnings suppression: call_time-aware semantics
algorithm_version.label: v24

classification.reason: Commit message names score-stage or score-context behavior.

source.commit_body:
The previous suppression window incorrectly neutralized volume signal on
{D-1, D, D+1} for any earnings event on date D, ignoring the existing
EarningsDate.call_time field. This nuked volume signal on the trading
day BEFORE earnings (a clean session) and missed AMC events whose impact
falls on the next trading session across weekends/holidays.

Correct semantics, now implemented in compute_earnings_suppressed_dates():
  BMO   (call_time < 09:30 ET): suppress earnings_date itself
  AMC   (call_time >= 16:00 ET): suppress next trading day after earnings
  INTRADAY (09:30-16:00 ET, rare): suppress earnings_date itself
  UNKNOWN (null/unparseable): conservative {ed, next_trading_day}

Trading-day awareness via PriceHistory dates handles AMC-Friday ->
Monday correctly, plus weekend/holiday earnings -> first trading day.

Smoke test on AAPL 2024-2025 (8 quarterly AMC earnings on Thursdays):
  OLD: 24 dates suppressed (Wed+Thu+Fri per event)
  NEW:  8 dates suppressed (Friday only per event)

Old code was zeroing volume signal on ~16 clean trading days per stock
per year (the day before + day of earnings). Universe-wide, this was
suppressing meaningful volume events on tens of thousands of trading
days where there was no actual earnings interference.

Files:
  volume_amplifier.py
    - _classify_call_time(str) -> BMO/AMC/INTRADAY/UNKNOWN
    - compute_earnings_suppressed_dates(rows, trading_dates) -> Set[date]
    - _analyze (DB path): inline call_time-aware check using PriceHistory
      for prev trading day + gap-day detection
    - _analyze_from_cache: parameter renamed earnings_suppressed_set,
      single-set membership lookup replaces 3-day window scan

  database/models/core.py (2 callers, calculate_scores_batched +
  recalculate batched path):
    - Load (date, call_time) tuples
    - Pass through compute_earnings_suppressed_dates with PriceHistory
      dates as trading calendar

  simulator.py:
    - StockContext now takes earnings_rows (date, call_time) tuples
    - Bulk load extended to fetch call_time
    - earnings_set built via compute_earnings_suppressed_dates

  test_volume_amplifier.py:
    - 17 new unit tests cover BMO/AMC/INTRADAY/UNKNOWN classification,
      Friday-AMC -> Monday carryover, weekend earnings, conservative
      UNKNOWN handling, the D-1-must-not-be-suppressed regression, etc.

This is a scoring change — volume_signal/volume_magnitude flow into
Score.overall via the volume amplifier multiplier. Requires
trader recalculate --force --full to rescore historical data with
the corrected suppression set.

source.commit_body:
Gradient dampener targeting calls (overall>=75) where the stochastic component
is below neutral AND the weekly adjustment is weakly positive. These signals
fire on trend/volume dominance while stoch contradicts — miss at +3.7pp above
baseline (z=+4.5, N=3,379, 46% of 75+ calls; 5y v32 ledger).

Mechanism (gradient, no hard gate):
  stoch_w  = clip((35 - stoch) / 35, 0, 1)  -- 0 at neutral=35, 1 at stoch=0
  wadj_w   = clip((12 - wadj)  / 11, 0, 1)  -- 0 at wadj=12, 1 at wadj=1
  weakness = stoch_w * wadj_w
  overall -= 0.30 * weakness * (overall - 55)

Calibrated via 175-variant gradient Bayesian sweep (stoch_wadj_bayes.py v2):
56/175 pass H1+H3+H4+H5. Winner: sn=35 (COMP_BINS anchor), wg=12, K=0.30.

(within H3 +-15%). Puts unchanged (H4). Sign-consistent 1y/3y/5y (H5).

Complements CWCF (v32, handles wadj<1); clean handoff at wadj=1.0 -- same
signal cannot trigger both. Exposes weight_info['cswc_dampen'] for explain-scores.

algorithm_version.git_message: v37 scoring: post-crash put dampener (PCD)
algorithm_version.label: v37

classification.reason: Commit message names score-stage or score-context behavior.

source.commit_body:
Vol-fair score-stage dampener that lifts put scores OUT of any put bucket
(<=25) when the underlying recently fell more than 1.0 stock-sigmas over
the last 10 trading bars. Eliminates the put-cohort regression where puts
firing immediately after sharp drops underperform the put baseline by
-7.15pp WR15 at the option-aligned barrier (z=-6.88, N=2,767 over 5y).

Mechanism (in compute_overall_score, applied AFTER continuation boost,
BEFORE earnings boost so the boost can't re-amplify a displaced peak):

    if overall <= 25 and ret_10d_sigma <= -1.0:
        overall = max(overall, 30)

ret_10d_sigma = ret_10d / (sigma_60 * sqrt(10)), where sigma_60 is the
60-day realized daily stdev — same vol definition the strategy's TP/SL
barriers use. Sigma-normalization corrects the stock-vol confound: a -10%
move is a 3sigma crash for low-vol KO but normal noise for high-vol PLTR;
the cohort regression is concentrated in low/mid-vol stocks (z=-5.03 vs
z=-1.63 for high-vol). Sigma cutoff applies the same crash semantics
across all stocks regardless of base volatility.

Per-trade ship gate H1-H5 (5y, option-aligned barrier 30dte_opt at W=15d):
  H1: <5 +2.95pp / <15 +3.22pp / <25 +1.56pp WR15 lift
  H2: WR15/WR30 directional consistency
  H3: ~30% of <=25 peaks displaced (designed; v27 WCF precedent dropped 75%);
      absolute floor N>>50 on every primary tier
  H4: puts strictly improved (this is the cohort suppression)
  H5: sign-consistent across 1y/3y/5y on all three put tiers
  Calls: 95+/90+/85+/80+/75+/70+ all unchanged (gate is overall<=25)

Plumbing: build_ret10d_sigma_map() joins per-symbol price history to a
{date: ret_10d_sigma} map at the start of each batch scorer (calculate_,
recalculate_scores_batched + simulator). Score.calculate_overall_score
single-row path does a lightweight 80-bar lookback when called outside
the batch context.

No portfolio params changed. No drift-guard impact (PCD lives in
scoring.py, not strategy_config.py). Investigation artifacts in
experiments/post_crash_v2/.

source.commit_body:
Score-stage gradient lift for puts in [16,20] near upcoming earnings,
replacing the EARN_SUPP_PUT cascade-stage filter (shipped 2026-04-26,
10 days live).  The score itself now drifts these signals OUT of put-
qualifying range so the dashboard doesn't show them as red badges

Mechanism (gradient over thresholds, applied BEFORE EARN_BOOST):

    if 16 <= overall <= 20 and 1 <= days_to_earnings <= 7:
        # Score gradient: peaks at 16-20, fades width 3
        score_grad = clip((overall-13)/3, 0, 1) for 16-17

threshold AND past EARN_BOOST's put gate (overall<=25), so subsequent
EARN_BOOST won't re-amplify on the put side.

algorithm_version.git_message: feat: MCD score-stage mcap dampener (mcap-aware call confidence weight)
algorithm_version.label: v43

classification.reason: Commit message names score-stage or score-context behavior.

source.commit_body:
Continuous, asymmetric (calls-only) score-stage dampener that drifts mid/
small-cap calls in [70, 84] toward TARGET=61 using log10(mcap_b) as a
smooth confidence shifter. Empirical cohort signal (5y v39, option-aligned
barrier 30dte_opt at W=15d): at fixed score, call TP rate scales monotonically
with mcap_b — large_50-200B 75+ TP=65.8% vs micro_lt2B 75+ TP=57.6% (8.2pp
spread, year-stable across 2022-2025).

Mechanism (dual power-law weakness, log-mcap input):
  weakness     = mcap_factor^MCAP_POWER * score_factor^SCORE_POWER
  mcap_factor  = clip((LOG_HI - log10(mcap_b)) / (LOG_HI - LOG_LO), 0, 1)
  score_factor = clip((overall - GATE_LO) / (GATE_HI - GATE_LO), 0, 1)
  overall     -= ALPHA * weakness * (overall - TARGET)

Ship params (calibrated via 15,195 variants, v3 stage-A + stage-B Bayesian
refinement around the basin):
  GATE_LO=70, GATE_HI=84
  LOG_LO=0.50 ($3.16B at full strength)
  LOG_HI=1.90 ($79.43B at zero strength)
  ALPHA=0.80, TARGET=61
  MCAP_POWER=0.70 (slightly concave mcap ramp)
  SCORE_POWER=1.50 (mild quadratic concentration at high scores)

H1-H5 ship gate (5y v39 baseline, option-aligned barrier 30dte_opt @ W=15d):
  75+ cumulative: 5y +2.73pp / 10y +2.96pp (sign-consistent both windows)
  Per-bucket: 70-74 +0.06pp (CALIBRATED), 75-79 +3.66pp (favorable
  over-correction), 80-84 -0.24pp (CALIBRATED), 85-89/90+ untouched
  (gate <= 84 leaves top tiers preserved by construction)
  Gradient gaps: [5.09, 2.41, 2.83, 6.09] — all >= 2.41pp (natural-wave
  gradient preserved)
  N drop on 75+: -44.9% (within v27 WCF precedent ~75% drop)
  Spillover on 80+/85+/90+: 0.00pp

Apply order: AFTER PCD (puts-only), BEFORE PESS (puts-only) and EARN_BOOST.
Calls-only mechanism (gate 70-84 ∧ mcap_b not None) so order vs PESS
doesn't matter mechanically; placement before EARN_BOOST ensures dampened
scores aren't re-amplified by earnings boost.

Plumbing: mcap_b loaded once per symbol from Stock.market_cap (structural,
not per-date). Wired through Score.calculate_overall_score (single-row),
Stock.calculate_scores_batched (batch), Stock.recalculate_scores_batched
(recalc), and simulator.StockContext (in-memory).

surfaced the signal) → experiments/mcap_dampener/ (3-generation sweep:
v1 linear 3,429 variants → v2 power-law 3,456 variants → v3 dense

algorithm_version.label: v69

source.commit_body:
Replaces the single current-week weekly adjustment with a point-in-time blend of
two honest weekly states, weighted by trading-bars-elapsed this week
(t = bars/5, Mon~0.2 -> Fri=1.0):
  comp_adj = calculate_weekly_adjustment(last-completed W-1, two-weeks-ago W-2)
             (state 1 = what live trader update already used; honest, ~1wk stale)
  pit_adj  = calculate_weekly_adjustment(partial current week W [reconstructed
             from daily bars Mon->date, NO future], last-completed W-1)
             (state 2 = freshest point-in-time, no future bars)
  w_adj    = (1-t)*comp_adj + t*pit_adj

Why: the batch/recalc path keyed the weekly on the CURRENT week and read the
stored COMPLETE Mon-Fri WeeklyScore for a mid-week historical signal = LOOK-AHEAD,
which inflated the backtest (live trader update was always honest via the
last-completed-week property). New production helper database/utils/weekly_pit.py
reconstructs the partial current week point-in-time (validated bit-identical to
live score_intraday_logs, mean|delta|=0.28, 97.5% within +/-2).

Validated (ScoreSimulator, no DB writes): look-ahead REMOVED -- 75+ cohort
optTP15 Mon-vs-Fri gap +8.4pp (state-3 look-ahead) -> -0.0pp (blend); honest 75+
optTP15 = 53.3% (Wilson-LB 49.6%, clears 45% call BE) vs the inflated 63.6%;
